issues: The definitive 'No' on PDF output is unsupported: the entry simply never mentions output formats.
Calling WAL the 'main result' overstates the entry, whose summary says the function projects cashflows.
The actual question, what IT Risk Scoring does, is never answered. No such function appears in the tool results, and the answer neither says so nor redirects.
It claims pyvar has no backtesting-exception function, but the search results only show a partial list and do not support this.
It maps the repeated context paragraph to functions instead of addressing the question asked.
States as fact that the function does not offer streaming results, but the function entry never mentions streaming either way.
Should have said the entry shows no streaming support rather than giving a definitive no.
The parameter and formula description is otherwise accurate.
The flat 'no GPU acceleration' claim is not supported: the function entry says nothing about GPU or hardware support.
It should have said the documentation does not mention GPU support instead of stating a definite no.
The description of the function and its parameters is accurate but does not answer the question.
The answer states flatly that pyvar does not offer Excel export, but the function entry never mentions export either way.
It should have said the entry does not cover export and pointed the visitor to other docs or support.
The function description itself (European option pricing, greeks via bump-and-reprice) is accurate.
Shows the degenerate example (amount 1, rollover rate 1) instead of the realistic accepted set with 500m/300m/200m tranches.
With a rollover rate of 1 the gap is zero, so the example does not illustrate rollover risk.
Example values are not shown as a JSON object.
